_meta.note: Each service is a 'journey' or detailed chapter. Grouped into the 3 main currents for interactive selection. Full details in modals/spotlights. No prices. Inquiry at end. Gear for rentals as key statistics.

services.title: Music Production
services.description: Full production for your tracks — from idea to final master. OTEO handles arrangement, sound design, mixing, and the details that make a record hit the floor right. Real club-focused work.
services.details: From the booth to the studio. Complete production packages tailored to House and Tech House. Includes stems, revisions, and club-ready masters.
services.fun_fact: Every production is tested in real rooms before delivery.

services.title: Ghost Production
services.description: Anonymous or credited production support. OTEO builds the tracks you need under your name or as co-writer. Full or partial — you decide the credit.
services.details: High-quality ghost production for labels, artists, and DJs. Original ideas or builds from your demos. Fast turnaround with revisions.
stats: Original ideas or builds from stems
services.fun_fact: Many floor weapons started as ghosts.

services.title: Engineering / Audio Engineering
services.description: Mixing, mastering, and technical cleanup. Bring your roughs or live recordings — OTEO makes them translation-proof and dancefloor-ready.
services.details: Professional engineering for club and streaming. Focus on low-end control, clarity, and energy. Includes stem mastering and format deliverables.
services.fun_fact: The low end is where the room decides.

services.title: Entertainment Coordinator
services.description: Full night programming and artist coordination. OTEO curates lineups, timings, and flow so the room never drops.
services.details: From openers to closers. Booking support, set time planning, and on-site coordination for residencies and special events.

services.title: Director
services.description: Creative direction for events, visuals, and experiences. OTEO shapes the whole night — sound, light, energy, and story.
services.details: Direction for club nights, parties, and branded events. Includes mood boards, cue lists, and real-time direction from the booth or floor.
services.fun_fact: Direction turns a good night into the one people talk about.

services.title: Equipment Rentals
services.description: Pro gear for your night. Full rider or single pieces. Delivered, set up, and collected. All maintained and rider-ready.
services.details: Rentals for clubs, private events, and productions. Includes transport and basic tech support. List is current as of latest inventory.
services.fun_fact: The right tools make the room move.

services.title: Demo Submissions
services.description: Send one private streamable link to Fish Out Of Water Records for consideration. A response is not guaranteed; FOOWR replies directly when a track fits the label.
services.details: Email or form for demos. Include links (SoundCloud, private Drive, etc.). Focus on dancefloor functionality. Feedback when possible.
services.fun_fact: The best records often come from the inbox.

inquiry.subject: Services Inquiry
inquiry.note: Tell me the service(s) you're interested in and any details about the project or night.
